svg.aria-label: Animated scene for ContribIQ: authored pull requests scroll through an eligibility gate that gives external PRs credit and strips own-repo PRs of it, a radar chart morphs across six scoring dimensions showing merged does not mean excellent, and a terminal shows a resume bullet linked to its PR while an unsupported claim is dropped.

g.text: // ContribIQ · GitHub history, scored on evidence
every claim must cite its PRs
• Fixed a Redis chord race so callbacks publish exactly once
× “led a team of 50” → no PR evidence, dropped
